A retired policeman’s family dinner gets interrupted by the gun trotting brother of Jalandhar’s most powerful man, who thinks the family has stolen his drugs. The scuffle sets up a transformative journey for every family member.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Karam Din
videos.overview: A retired policeman’s family dinner gets interrupted by the gun trotting brother of Jalandhar’s most powerful man, who thinks the family has stolen his drugs. The scuffle sets up a transformative journey for every family member.

videos.title: Jhooth
videos.overview: Singh family struggles to keep the secret. Ajeet builds his election campaign to make Punjab drug-free. When a video of his missing brother threatens to derail his plans, he sends Multan to find him. A neighbour of Omkar gets a whiff of the secret.

videos.title: Sach
videos.overview: Sargun seeks heavenly interventions to save her family while Omkar struggles to keep the secret a secret. Tegi feels Omkar treats him unfairly, Happy has lies to hide. Lucky finds a clue. Mahajan solves the puzzle and learns about the family secret.

videos.title: Tureya Ja
videos.overview: Maheep’s dead body is discovered in a canal, Mahajan blackmails Omkar. Tegi calls his father a coward and cooks his own plans to sell drugs that land him in trouble. Lucky is assigned the murder case, and Omkar overcomes his fears to save Tegi.

videos.title: Kaala
videos.overview: Mahajan plays a double game and pays the price for it. Happy faces tough choices. Palak loses faith in Happy and seeks help from Lucky, who is madly in love with her. Omkar’s descend into hell begins and Sargun feels buried under the guilt.

videos.title: Ishq
videos.overview: Lucky investigates Mahajan’s murder to win the love of his life Palak, only to learn she is having a secret affair. Omkar and Sargun try to start afresh, Happy finds a job at Ajeet’s company, they have a plan. Lucky connects the dots.

videos.title: Hanera
videos.overview: Lucky lays a trap for Omkar, Happy plants evidences against Ajeet. Multan wakes up from the coma. Two killers kidnap Omkar and Sargun. Ajeet’s political rival gets another chance, and Sargun faces a difficult choice.

videos.title: Birha
videos.overview: Pankaj makes a deal with Ajeet. Omkar struggles to save his family and Sargun loses her mind. Every choice has a price to pay.
